what_it_does: Central Depository Services (India) Ltd operates as a market infrastructure institution, maintaining demat accounts and providing secure depository services to issuers and investors in India's securities market, earning revenue from depository operations and related digital and regulatory services.
other_facts: CDSL crossed 18 crore demat accounts and maintained an 80% market share during FY 2025-26.
CDSL Ventures Limited crossed 10 crore KYC records.
The company ended the year serving over 48 thousand issuers and managing 1.26 lakh ISINs.
